chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad al-Ashʿarī, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Abī al-Faḍl ʿAbdullāh ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, who said:
I was in the presence of Abī Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام, and I brought up the differing of the Shīʿah.

So he said: O Muḥammad, indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, never ceased being singular in His Oneness. Then He created Muḥammad, and ʿAlī, and Fāṭimah. Then they remained for a thousand dahr. Then He created all things, and made them witness their creation, and caused their obedience to be binding upon them, and delegated their affairs to them. So they make halal whatever they will, and make haram whatever they will; and they do not will except that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, wills.
Then he said: O Muḥammad, this is the religion such that whoever goes ahead of it slips away, whoever falls behind it is effaced, and whoever adheres to it joins it. Take it to yourself, O Muḥammad.

key_terms.أَلْفَ دَهْرٍ: A thousand ages or vast spans of time before the creation of all things.
key_terms.الدِّينَةُ: The religion or divinely ordained path referred to in the narration.
key_terms.طَاعَتَهُمْ: The obedience due to them by divine command.
key_terms.فَوَّضَ: He delegated or consigned authority over affairs.
key_terms.لَزِمَهَا: He adhered to it firmly and remained committed to it.
key_terms.يُحَرِّمُونَ: They declare forbidden by Allah’s granted authority.
key_terms.يُحِلُّونَ: They declare lawful by Allah’s granted authority.

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith from al-Kāfī say about the creation and authority of Muḥammad, ʿAlī, and Fāṭimah?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a theological and cosmological statement about the precedence of Muḥammad, ʿAlī, and Fāṭimah in creation and their divinely granted authority by Allah, Blessed and Exalted. It concludes by framing this teaching as the true religion: excess beyond it leads astray, falling short of it leads to loss, and firm adherence to it leads to salvation.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Abu Al Fazl Abdullah Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Sinan who said,
‘I was in the presence of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup>, so I flowed (the discussion) of the differing of the Shias.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Muhammad! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High did not cease to be Individual by His<sup>azwj</sup> Oneness. Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Created Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, and Ali<sup>asws</sup>, and (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup>. So they<sup>asws</sup> remained for ‘أَلْفَ دَهْرٍ’ a thousand Dahr (one Dahr equals the amount of time earth’s existence). Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the entirety of the things. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Made them<sup>asws</sup> witness their creation, and Caused to flow their<sup>asws</sup> obedience to be upon these, and Authorised their affairs to them<sup>asws</sup>. Thus, they<sup>asws</sup> are permitting whatever they are so desiring, and permitting whatever they<sup>asws</sup> wish, and they<sup>asws</sup> are never desiring except what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Blessed and High Desires’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! This here is the Religion which (if) one who goes ahead of it (exaggerates), would miss it, and the one who remains behind from it would be obliterated, and the one who holds it properly would preserve it. Take it to yourself, O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>!’
en.sarwar: 4. Ahmad has narrated from al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu Hamza who has said the following.

“Allah, the Most High sent revelation to Muhammad (s.a.) saying, “O Muhammad I created you. You did not exist. I blew into you from My spirit. It was an honor with which I honored you when I made it an obligation on all My creatures to obey you. Whoever would obey you has obeyed Me and whoever would dis obey you has disobeyed Me. I made this an obligation in the case of Ali and those of his descendants whom I have chosen for My-self.”
